name: Pipfiend: The Demonic Domino Deckbuilder
description:
About This Game

You've signed away your soul to a mysterious demon only to find yourself trapped in a special dimension of his own creation, forced to battle for his amusement with his weapon of choice: dominoes! Chain together combos, be strategic about your suits, and battle your way through his hordes of minions until you can challenge The Dominarch himself! And maybe you'll discover something even deeper...

Nearly 75,000 possible dominoes are available in your attempt to defeat The Dominarch and break the contract you foolishly signed.

Powerful Materials all with their own special effects:

  • Flint

  • Magnetic

  • Prismatic

  • And more...

Strange Enemies with Disrupting Abilities:

Use Game-Altering Charms to bend the run to your will!

Master arcane powers and twist the powers of the Dominarch against Him! Over 100 charms offer countless combinations of synergistic effects, giving you the ability to turn any disadvantage into massive power!
short_desc: A roguelike deckbuilder about battling demons with a specialized deck of dominoes! Build your deck from nearly 75,000 possible unique configurations of dominoes, and augment your run with powerful charms and discover diabolical synergies.
